meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除对细胞的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在代谢工程或系统生物学中需要模拟基因敲除的影响。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network fluxes and predict gene knockout effects.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you model metabolism and need gene knockout simulation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 Python 库 cobrapy 分析代谢模型:运行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样等模拟,计算最小培养基,读写 SBML 等格式的模型文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求加载或构建代谢模型,或提出 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、培养基优化等代谢工程问题时触发。

say.text: 用大肠杆菌核心模型跑一次 FBA,预测它的生长速率。
say.note: 会加载自带模型并求解。

say.text: 对 b0008 基因做单基因敲除,看生长速率变化。
计算这个模型在 50% 最大生长下的最小培养基。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the Python library cobrapy to analyze metabolic models: run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, compute minimal media, and read/write SBML, JSON, YAML model files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to load or build a metabolic model, or to run FBA, FVA, gene knockout, or media optimization analyses.

say_en.text: Run FBA on the E. coli core model and predict its growth rate.
say_en.note: Loads the bundled model and optimizes.

say_en.text: Perform a single gene knockout of b0008 and check growth change.
Compute the minimal medium supporting 50% of maximal growth.
